entities.summary: The Evangelical Lutheran Free Church is a confessional Lutheran denomination based in Germany and Austria. It currently consists of 1,300 members in 17 congregations. The ELFK maintains a seminary for the training of pastors in the city of Leipzig. Evangelical Lutheran Free Church is a Christian denomination. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
